entries.original: The stream-stall hint now reads "Waiting for API response · will retry in …" instead of "No response from API · Retrying in …", and triggers after 20s of silence instead of 10s
entries.translated: stream-stall 힌트 문구가 기존 "No response from API · Retrying in …"에서 "Waiting for API response · will retry in …"로 변경되었으며, 실행 조건이 무응답 10초에서 20초로 조정되었습니다.
